road.songTitle: One For My Baby (And One More For The Road)
road.line: Old and steady can't carry his load
stanza: And don't let it be said
Old and steady can't carry his load
Make it one for my baby
And one more for the road
That long, long, long, long road
Yes, that long, long, long road

partner.line: And one more for the road

road.songTitle: My Old Kentucky Home, Good Night
road.line: A few more days for to tote the weary load
stanza: The head must bow and the back will have to bend
Wherever the darkies may go
A few more days and the trouble all will end
In the field where the sugar-canes grow
A few more days for to tote the weary load
No matter 'twill never be light
A few more days till we totter on the road
Then my old Kentucky home, good-night!

partner.line: A few more days till we totter on the road
